run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-16T07:51:32Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate warning for otel-demo/frontend traces to two configuration-only rollout restarts at 2026-11-16T07:49:58Z: Deployment ad and Deployment payment, each with a single replica, had their only pods terminated at 07:50:01-07:50:02 and replaced from new ReplicaSets (ad-6cb57f76d, payment-9c8ffb665) whose pod template differs from the previous revision only by annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-16T07:49:58Z (same image tag 2.1.3, env, resources). The new ad container started at 07:50:00 but its application first logged 'Ad service starting.' at 07:54:25.827 and 'Ad service started, listening on 8080' at 07:56:19.226; neither ad nor payment defines a readinessProbe, so the pod was Ready and service endpoints were routed while nothing was listening on 8080. frontend's error-status span rate was exactly 0 from 07:28:32 through 07:50:32, rose to 0.337/s at 07:51:32, peaked near 3.98/s at 07:55:32 and returned to 0 from 08:00:00. frontend's 500s are propagation: GET /api/data and executing api route (pages) /api/data fail on child span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds with rpc.grpc.status_code 14 and '14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect ECONNREFUSED 100.65.180.246:8080', and POST /api/checkout / executing api route (pages) /api/checkout fail on grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder with rpc.grpc.status_code 13 '13 INTERNAL: failed to charge card ... dial tcp 100.70.188.60:8080: connect: connection refused'. Service ad (100.65.180.246:8080) and Service payment (100.70.188.60:8080) are exactly those cluster IPs. The ad restart dominates (AdService/GetAds error spans up to 1.389/s, non-zero 07:51-07:59); the simultaneous payment restart contributed the smaller checkout component (CheckoutService/PlaceOrder up to 0.444/s, non-zero 07:51-07:54). frontend-proxy shows matching 500s only on ingress / router frontend egress. The frontend pod itself was not restarted (started 07:16:16Z, restartCount 0, ReplicaSet from 07:16:15Z). All 21 pods are Running/Ready with restartCount 0 and all Deployments 1/1 available at query time, so the burst was transient.

claims.text: At 2026-11-16T07:51:32Z the error-status span rate was 0.337/s for service frontend and 0.163/s for service frontend-proxy; ad, payment, checkout, cart, currency, product-catalog, quote, shipping, accounting, email and image-provider all returned STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0, while recommendation and fraud-detection each returned 0.0037/s.

In the 5 minutes ending 07:51:32, frontend error-status spans were confined to two call paths: AdService path (span_name grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds 0.0444/s, GET /api/data 0.0444/s, executing api route (pages) /api/data 0.0444/s) and checkout path (grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 0.0333/s, POST /api/checkout 0.0333/s, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout 0.0333/s), plus wrapper spans GET 0.0444/s, POST 0.0333/s and tcp.connect 0.0259/s; GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart and grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem were 0.
frontend-proxy error-status spans in the same window are only span_name 'ingress' 0.0815/s and 'router frontend egress' 0.0815/s.

Per-operation frontend error rate over 07:40-08:05 (2-minute rate): grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, GET /api/data and executing api route (pages) /api/data rise together to 1.389/s at 07:53:00 and are non-zero 07:51:00-07:59:00; grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, POST /api/checkout and executing api route (pages) /api/checkout peak at 0.444/s at 07:52:00 and are non-zero only 07:51:00-07:54:00; tcp.connect errors appear 07:51:00-07:58:00.

Trace b6372c024d7931e1d115ceda2651efe8 shows frontend GET /api/data with http.status_code 500 whose exception is '14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect ECONNREFUSED 100.65.180.246:8080 (2025-12-15T17:50:45.363Z)', with child span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds carrying otel.status_code ERROR and rpc.grpc.status_code 14; frontend-proxy ingress and router frontend egress spans in that trace carry 500/ERROR, and load-generator's GET span carries 500/ERROR.

Trace f9632df3f1388a8011baad26248e0c46 shows frontend POST /api/checkout and executing api route (pages) /api/checkout as HTTP 500 with exception '13 INTERNAL: failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection error: desc = "transport: Error while dialing: dial tcp 100.70.188.60:8080: connect: connection refused"', and child span grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder with rpc.grpc.status_code 13 (this evidence view is flagged incomplete/truncated; 30 of 178 rows were read).

Service ad has clusterIP 100.65.180.246 with port 8080 targetPort 8080 and selector opentelemetry.io/name=ad; Service payment has clusterIP 100.70.188.60 with port 8080 targetPort 8080 and selector opentelemetry.io/name=payment, so the refused addresses in frontend's error spans are the ad and payment Service IPs.

otel-demo events show ad-6cb57f76d Scheduled and SuccessfulCreate at 07:49:58, Deployment ad ScalingReplicaSet 0->1 at 07:49:58, container ad Created/Started 07:50:00, old pod ad-554b849958-mbnxm Killing at 07:50:01 and SuccessfulDelete, ReplicaSet ad-554b849958 scaled 1->0 at 07:50:01; and payment-9c8ffb665-qrm84 Scheduled 07:49:58, SuccessfulCreate 07:49:58, Deployment payment scaled 0->1 07:49:58, container payment Started 07:50:01, old pod payment-55766d76b9-c4wgb Killing 07:50:02 with SuccessfulDelete and ReplicaSet payment-55766d76b9 scaled 1->0 at 07:50:02.

ReplicaSets ad-6cb57f76d and payment-9c8ffb665 (both deployment revision 2) are identical to revision 1 except for pod template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-16T07:49:58Z: image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad and :2.1.3-payment, the same env, port 8080, and the same resources (ad limits cpu 50m/memory 450Mi, requests cpu 10m/memory 225Mi; payment limits cpu 20m/memory 160Mi, requests cpu 10m/memory 80Mi).

Only two ReplicaSets in otel-demo were created after 07:40:00Z: ad-6cb57f76d (owner ad) and payment-9c8ffb665 (owner payment), both at 2026-11-16T07:49:58Z; frontend's ReplicaSet frontend-675fd7b5c5 dates from 07:16:15Z.

ad-6cb57f76d-xmcq6 container ad started at 07:50:00Z with restartCount 0; its first logged lines are 'Ad service starting.' at 2026-11-16T07:54:25.827465751Z and 'Ad service started, listening on 8080' at 2026-11-16T07:56:19.226369917Z, and the 07:49:50-07:54:00 read of that pod returned no lines with lines_before_window 0.

Deployments ad and payment define containers ad and payment with readinessProbe null and livenessProbe null; both report observedGeneration 2, deployment revision 2, updatedReplicas 1 and Progressing/NewReplicaSetAvailable update times of 07:50:01 and 07:50:02.

payment-9c8ffb665-qrm84 container payment started at 07:50:01Z with restartCount 0; its retained log stream is 593 lines whose earliest line is 'Charge request received.' at 2026-11-16T07:51:46.193Z (the 07:50:40-07:51:50 read reports lines_before_window 0), and it logs 'Transaction complete.' after each charge; checkout logged 'payment went through' from 07:53:42Z.

service ad span rate fell from 2.189/s at 07:51:00 to 0.900/s at 07:52:00 and was 0/s from 07:53:00 through 07:59:00, resuming at 1.968/s at 08:00:00; service payment span rate was 1.444/s at 07:51:00, 0.511/s at 07:52:00, 0 at 07:53:00 and 1.233/s at 07:54:00. Both services reported STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0 throughout.

At query time all 21 otel-demo pods are phase Running and Ready with restartCount 0 and no lastState.terminated reason (including ad-6cb57f76d-xmcq6 and payment-9c8ffb665-qrm84, container state running), all 21 Deployments report ready=1 and available=1 with unavailable null, and frontend-675fd7b5c5-h8sk5 container frontend started 07:16:16Z with restartCount 0.

The only other error-status spans in the namespace are recommendation span_name '/flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream' 0.0037/s and fraud-detection span_name 'flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream' 0.0037/s; their 5-minute error rate oscillates between 0 and 0.0044/s across 07:28:32-08:02:32, i.e. it exists before the 07:50 restart and after the burst ends.

Deployment ad is the dominant origin of the alert: its only pod was replaced by the 07:49:58 configuration-only restart, the old pod was terminated at 07:50:01, the replacement container started 07:50:00 but did not log listening on 8080 until 07:56:19 (no readinessProbe, so the pod was Ready with no listener), ad trace traffic went to zero 07:53-07:59, and frontend/checkout calls to Service ad 100.65.180.246:8080 were refused, producing frontend GET /api/data 500s and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds error spans up to 1.389/s.

Deployment payment contributed a second, smaller error component by the same mechanism: its only pod was replaced by the same 07:49:58 restart, the old pod stopped at 07:50:02, the new container started 07:50:01 but its earliest retained log line is 07:51:46.193 and payment trace traffic dropped to 0 at 07:53:00, while checkout's charge call to Service payment 100.70.188.60:8080 was refused and surfaced as frontend POST /api/checkout 500s with grpc Error 13 INTERNAL 'failed to charge card' (peak 0.444/s at 07:52:00, zero again from 07:55:00).

The roughly six-minute gap between the ad container starting at 07:50:00 and the application logging 'listening on 8080' at 07:56:19 may be aggravated by the ad container's CPU limit of 50m against a 10m request; no CPU-throttling or container-start-duration metric was available to confirm this, so it remains unverified.

AdService error spans remain non-zero through the 07:59:00 evaluation bucket even though the ad application logged listening at 07:56:19, which is consistent with gRPC client channel reconnection backoff in frontend rather than continued server-side unavailability; the frontend's gRPC channel state cannot be read from the available evidence.

Rejected: the ad or payment pods crashed, were OOMKilled or entered BackOff. Both report restartCount 0, a single running container state with no lastState.terminated reason, and their own Deployment controller emitted SuccessfulCreate plus SuccessfulDelete of the previous pods, i.e. a ReplicaSet revision 1->2 rollout rather than crash replacement.

Rejected: a frontend restart or rollout caused the burst. frontend-675fd7b5c5-h8sk5 started at 07:16:16Z with restartCount 0, its ReplicaSet was created at 07:16:15Z, and no frontend ReplicaSet was created after 07:40.

The burst was transient and had ended: frontend error-status span rate is 0 from 08:02:32 onward, all 21 pods are Running/Ready with restartCount 0, and all 21 Deployments are 1/1 available at query time, so the currently observed state no longer exhibits the alert condition.

No unrelated dependency fault is visible: in the 5-minute window ending 07:51:32 services ad, payment, checkout, cart, currency, product-catalog, quote, shipping, accounting, email and image-provider all returned STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0, and the only non-frontend error spans are the pre-existing sporadic flagd EventStream errors on recommendation/fraud-detection that also occur outside the burst.

Add a readinessProbe (TCP or gRPC health on port 8080) to the ad, payment and other single-replica otel-demo Deployments so a container that is not yet listening is kept out of Service endpoints, and consider raising the ad container's 50m CPU limit, since the ad application needed over six minutes from container start to bind port 8080.

For single-replica Deployments in otel-demo, stagger maintenance restarts of ad and payment (or use maxSurge with a readiness gate) instead of restarting both simultaneously, and verify Service endpoints are non-empty throughout the transition.

gaps: The RequestErrorRate alerting rule could not be read: list_prometheus_rules for rule_name RequestErrorRate returned status no_data, so the rule expression and the meaning of the annotation value 2.5777777777777775 are unverified. get_metric_names for {__name__=~"http_.*|rpc_.*"} also returned no_data, so no HTTP/RPC-level metric series could be checked.

change_history is not an integrated data source, so who or what issued kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-16T07:49:58Z on Deployments ad and payment, and why, is unknown; only the annotation and controller events prove the restart.
The returned otel-demo events cover only 07:49:58-07:50:02, so any other cluster activity inside the incident window is unknown.

Trace evidence is a biased, partial sample: the 07:21:32-07:51:32 frontend error query held 178 spans of which 30 were read (view truncated), and the earlier whole-window frontend trace query failed with RESULT_TOO_LARGE (464 spans) and was never read, so total error counts and full call chains are unknown.
Trace span-metric series begin at 07:28:32, so no 24-hour baseline exists; the pre-incident baseline used is the 22-minute interval 07:28:32-07:50:32 with an error rate of exactly 0.

Frontend application logs could not be used: fetch_pod_logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-h8sk5 returned status no_data with an empty current stream and no previous container instance, so frontend-side error logging is unverified.

One ad log read (68693763-28d1-4c88-9eef-0f35c4bebda8-t1:4fbeea81-94b4-4730-b2bd-e3fe5bdc2cc5) and one payment log read (8b186178-069d-465a-a1b7-6bbb56def0d1-t0:6cecb2ed-7444-4d23-8f2a-f1576d8aed32) returned status no_data; absence of lines in those slices is not proof the containers logged nothing then, and the gap between container start and first application log is therefore bounded only by the retained-stream reads cited above.

No CPU-throttling or container-start-duration metric exists in the queried source, so the contribution of the ad container's limits.cpu 50m to its slow start, and the role of its flagd dependency (FLAGD_HOST=flagd:8013) during startup, are unverified.

The gRPC UNAVAILABLE message embeds a stale timestamp '(2025-12-15T17:50:45.363Z)'; its origin is unexplained, and whether a connection backoff or a still-unready server caused the residual 07:56-07:59 AdService errors could not be determined.

Impact on callers beyond frontend was checked only through aggregate error series: a single trace (b6372c024d7931e1d115ceda2651efe8) shows a load-generator GET span with http.status_code 500, but load-generator's own error rate and customer-facing consequences were not verified.
next_steps: Retrieve the RequestErrorRate rule definition from the alerting Prometheus (the rule listing returned no_data here) to confirm what the 2.5777 value measures.
Consult the change-history/audit source (not integrated in this Run) to identify who ran the 07:49:58Z restart on Deployments ad and payment and whether it was maintenance.

Add readinessProbes on port 8080 to the ad, payment and other single-replica otel-demo Deployments and raise the ad container's CPU limit; then repeat a controlled restart to confirm endpoints stay populated.
Instrument or scrape container CPU throttling and application start-to-listen duration for ad to test the low-CPU-limit hypothesis.
Check load-generator's error rate for the 07:50-08:00 window to quantify client-side impact that this Run only sampled.

hypothesis.text: Deployment ad is the dominant origin of the alert: its only pod was replaced by the 07:49:58 configuration-only restart, the old pod was terminated at 07:50:01, the replacement container started 07:50:00 but did not log listening on 8080 until 07:56:19 (no readinessProbe, so the pod was Ready with no listener), ad trace traffic went to zero 07:53-07:59, and frontend/checkout calls to Service ad 100.65.180.246:8080 were refused, producing frontend GET /api/data 500s and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds error spans up to 1.389/s.

Deployment payment contributed a second, smaller error component by the same mechanism: its only pod was replaced by the same 07:49:58 restart, the old pod stopped at 07:50:02, the new container started 07:50:01 but its earliest retained log line is 07:51:46.193 and payment trace traffic dropped to 0 at 07:53:00, while checkout's charge call to Service payment 100.70.188.60:8080 was refused and surfaced as frontend POST /api/checkout 500s with grpc Error 13 INTERNAL 'failed to charge card' (peak 0.444/s at 07:52:00, zero again from 07:55:00).

The roughly six-minute gap between the ad container starting at 07:50:00 and the application logging 'listening on 8080' at 07:56:19 may be aggravated by the ad container's CPU limit of 50m against a 10m request; no CPU-throttling or container-start-duration metric was available to confirm this, so it remains unverified.

AdService error spans remain non-zero through the 07:59:00 evaluation bucket even though the ad application logged listening at 07:56:19, which is consistent with gRPC client channel reconnection backoff in frontend rather than continued server-side unavailability; the frontend's gRPC channel state cannot be read from the available evidence.

recommendation.text: Add a readinessProbe (TCP or gRPC health on port 8080) to the ad, payment and other single-replica otel-demo Deployments so a container that is not yet listening is kept out of Service endpoints, and consider raising the ad container's 50m CPU limit, since the ad application needed over six minutes from container start to bind port 8080.

For single-replica Deployments in otel-demo, stagger maintenance restarts of ad and payment (or use maxSurge with a readiness gate) instead of restarting both simultaneously, and verify Service endpoints are non-empty throughout the transition.

counter_evidence.text: The burst was transient and had ended: frontend error-status span rate is 0 from 08:02:32 onward, all 21 pods are Running/Ready with restartCount 0, and all 21 Deployments are 1/1 available at query time, so the currently observed state no longer exhibits the alert condition.

No unrelated dependency fault is visible: in the 5-minute window ending 07:51:32 services ad, payment, checkout, cart, currency, product-catalog, quote, shipping, accounting, email and image-provider all returned STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0, and the only non-frontend error spans are the pre-existing sporadic flagd EventStream errors on recommendation/fraud-detection that also occur outside the burst.

rejected_hypothesis.text: Rejected: the ad or payment pods crashed, were OOMKilled or entered BackOff. Both report restartCount 0, a single running container state with no lastState.terminated reason, and their own Deployment controller emitted SuccessfulCreate plus SuccessfulDelete of the previous pods, i.e. a ReplicaSet revision 1->2 rollout rather than crash replacement.

Rejected: a frontend restart or rollout caused the burst. frontend-675fd7b5c5-h8sk5 started at 07:16:16Z with restartCount 0, its ReplicaSet was created at 07:16:15Z, and no frontend ReplicaSet was created after 07:40.
